purpose: Deterministic predictive benchmark partition; no model training
partition_unit: one row per unique UCI client identifier
temporal_limitation: The source describes April-September 2005 predictors and a next-month default label, but does not establish a sufficiently precise operational observation cutoff or target window. This random split is not temporal or out-of-time validation.

fit_policy.validation_use: model selection and threshold selection only
fit_policy.test_use: single final evaluation after model and threshold are frozen
